title: Influence of Lester Young, Illinois Jacquet and Scott Hamilton
summary: Tate says Jacquet inspired him to play more than Prez, and that Hamilton does too.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Coleman Hawkins and the great saxophonists

blocks.x: Yeah, he really did. Actually, he did a lot of things -- he made me always -- made me want to play. But Jacquet- I got more Jacquet - playing with Jacq', I got more vibes for one to play when he was in the band than I did with Prez. Because when Jacq' came in the band, man, he was really -- he was cooking.

Yeah, when he'd take away from that -- you know, that other thing, you know like he did that reed squeaking. But I mean, just actually playing, man. When he came in that band, shit, he was really burning, man. And he made you want to play, you know, and I think he inspired me more wanting to play, of having desire -- now, Scott does, too, and whenever he and I play together, I don't ever get tired. I feel like playing all night because he plays interesting things all night.
